tips.title: Select solid entities
tips.body: Use `om.commands.select.GetEntities(types=om.commands.select.EntityTypeSelection.SOLID)` to select all solid entities.

tips.title: Select curve entities by layer
tips.body: Use `om.commands.select.GetEntities(types=om.commands.select.EntityTypeSelection.ALL_CURVES, layers='layer0')` to select all curve entities on layer 'layer0'.

tips.title: Select entities by ID
tips.body: Use `om.commands.select.GetEntitiesById([1, 2, 4])` to select entities with specific IDs.

tips.title: Select pre-selected entities
tips.body: Use `om.commands.select.GetPreSelection()` to get entities that have been selected in the model.

tips.title: Inspect entity geometry
tips.body: Check if an entity is a `GeomEntity` and access its geometry using `ent.Geometry`, which returns a `TopoGeom`.

tips.title: Change entity layer
tips.body: Create a new layer with `layer_manager.AddLayer('newLayer')` and move entities to it using `layer_manager.MoveToLayer(ents, layer)`.

tips.title: Read geometric information from an entity
tips.body: Get the geometry of a face using `face_ent.Geometry`, then access its surface and domain.

tips.title: Create a cone shape using notable points
tips.body: Use `om.commands.shapes.CreateConeShape(centerPoint, baseRadius=10., height=50.)` to create a cone at specific points.

tips.title: Open an undo entry
tips.body: Call `cad_model.OpenUndo('script_0')` before executing a script to create a single undo entry.

tips.title: Close an undo entry
tips.body: Call `cad_model.CloseUndo()` to close the current undo entry.

tips.title: Convert angle units
tips.body: Use `math.radians(degrees)` to convert degrees to radians for API functions that require radian values.

tips.title: Work with multiple workplanes
tips.body: Create a new workplane using `cad_model.Workplanes.Add('wp1')` and switch to it.

tips.title: Create a 2D chamfer on curves
tips.body: Use `om.commands.drafting.Create2DChamfers` with parameters like `curves`, `trim`, `mode`, `distance1`, `distance2`, and `angle`. Default values are provided for each parameter.

tips.title: Create a 2D fillet on curves
tips.body: Use `om.commands.drafting.Create2DFillets` with parameters like `curves`, `radius`, `trim`, and `curvesParameters`. Default values are provided for each parameter.

tips.title: Create intersection points between entities
tips.body: Use `om.commands.drafting.CreateIntersectionPoints` with parameters like `firstEntity`, `secondEntities`, `extensions`, and `all`. Default values are provided for each parameter.

tips.title: Create points on a curve
tips.body: Use `om.commands.drafting.CreatePointsOnCurve` with parameters like `curves`, `mode`, `startU`, `endU`, `nPoints`, `onExtension`, and `inflDirection`. Default values are provided for each parameter.

tips.title: Create points on a face
tips.body: Use `om.commands.drafting.CreatePointsOnFace` with parameters like `faces`, `u`, `nPointsU`, `v`, `nPointsV`, `onDomain`, and `pointCloud`. Default values are provided for each parameter.

tips.title: Create a parallel line to a base line
tips.body: Use `om.commands.drafting.CreateParallelLine` with parameters like `baseLine`, `fixedAngle`, `angle`, `length`, `definitionMode`, `symmetric`, `nCopies`, `distance`, and `parallelToXY`. Default values are provided for each parameter.

tips.title: Create contour curves from shapes
tips.body: Use `om.commands.curves.CreateShapeContourCurvesLinear`, `om.commands.curves.CreateShapeContourCurvesRotational`, or `om.commands.curves.CreateShapeContourCurves3D` to generate contour curves based on selected shapes in a specified plane.

tips.title: Wrap curves to a face
tips.body: Use `om.commands.curves.CreateWrappingCurves` to wrap planar curves and text onto a rotated face, specifying wrapping mode, initial point, direction, and other parameters.

tips.title: Create a guided face along curves
tips.body: Use `om.commands.shapes.CreateAlongGuideShape` to create a guided face based on contour curves led along guide curves, specifying mode, reference entities, and other parameters.

tips.title: Create a blended face between two boundaries
tips.body: Use `om.commands.shapes.CreateBlendingShape` to insert a blending face (NURBS) between two faces with a tangentially constant transition, specifying weights and inversion.

tips.title: Create faces from coplanar curves
tips.body: Use `om.commands.shapes.CreateBoundedPlaneShapes` to create faces from coplanar curves, planar boundaries, and almost planar boundaries.

tips.title: Close openings within faces
tips.body: Use `om.commands.shapes.CreateCloseHolesShapes` to close openings within selected faces, specifying layers and options for closing cross-holes.

tips.title: Create Chamfer Shape
tips.body: Use `om.commands.shapes.CreateChamferShape` to create a chamfer between two faces. Parameters include mode, distances, angle, and more.

tips.title: Create Shape from Grid
tips.body: Use `om.commands.shapes.CreateFromGridShape` to create a shape using a grid of curves.

tips.title: Boolean Union
tips.body: Use `om.commands.booleans.CreateBooleanUnion` to join multiple solids into a single solid.

tips.title: Boolean Difference
tips.body: Use `om.commands.booleans.CreateBooleanDifference` to remove areas of one solid that intersect with another.

tips.title: Boolean Intersection
tips.body: Use `om.commands.booleans.CreateBooleanIntersection` to create a solid from the areas that intersect with each other.

tips.title: Boolean Split
tips.body: Use `om.commands.booleans.CreateBooleanSplit` to split a solid using another solid.

tips.title: Split Curves
tips.body: Use `om.commands.modify.SplitCurves` to split one or several curves via boundaries or at their NURBS arc joints.

tips.title: Split Faces by Parameter
tips.body: Use `om.commands.modify.SplitFacesByParameter` to split faces along isoparametric curves.

tips.title: Split Faces by Joints
tips.body: Use `om.commands.modify.SplitFacesByJoints` to split faces at the NURBS arc joints.

tips.title: Deform Entities
tips.body: Use `om.commands.modify.DeformEntities` to deform selected entities using fixed points and target points.

tips.title: Set initial and target curves for deformation
tips.body: Use `initialCurves` and `targetCurves` parameters to specify the starting and ending shapes.

tips.title: Control continuity of deformed faces
tips.body: Set `targetCurvesContinuity` to either POSITION or G1 for tangency constraint.

tips.title: Invert curve orientation
tips.body: Use `invertedCurves` to reverse the direction of selected curves.

tips.title: Adjust number of iterations for deformation
tips.body: Set `nIterations` to control the refinement level of the deformation process.

tips.title: Regularize space during deformation
tips.body: Enable `regularizeSpace` to ensure even distribution of deformation across the space.

tips.title: Set NURBS tolerance for conversion
tips.body: Use `nurbsTolerance` to specify the positional conversion tolerance for NURBS entities.

tips.title: Specify maximum degree for NURBS conversion
tips.body: Set `nurbsMaxDegree` to define the highest degree of NURBS entities.

tips.title: Skip conversion of existing NURBS entities
tips.body: Enable `skipNURBS` to avoid re-converting entities that are already in NURBS format.

tips.title: Convert entities to analytical geometry
tips.body: Use `om.commands.modify.ConvertToAnalytical` to convert NURBS entities into analytical geometry.

tips.title: Set conversion tolerance for analytical geometry
tips.body: Use `conversionTolerance` to specify the precision of the conversion process.

tips.title: Keep original entities during conversion
tips.body: Set `keepOriginal` to true if you want the original entities to be retained after conversion.

tips.title: Simplify selected entities
tips.body: Use `om.commands.modify.Simplify` to reduce the complexity of faces, boundaries, and curves.

tips.title: Set tolerance for simplification
tips.body: Use `tolerance` to specify the maximum size of gaps within selected entities.

tips.title: Set angular tolerance for curve extension
tips.body: angularTolerance: float, optional - controls deviation from mutual tangency; default is 0.1

tips.title: Modify curve continuity
tips.body: MakeContinuityCurve: modifies transition between two curves; parameters include continuity type and propagation

tips.title: Invert face UV direction
tips.body: InvertFaceUV: inverts U and V direction of isoparametric curves; mode options include INVERT_UV, INVERT_V, INVERT_BOTH

tips.title: Trim faces by limits
tips.body: TrimFacesByLimits: trims faces at boundaries; parameters include projection direction and forwardOnly mode

tips.title: Trim faces by plane
tips.body: TrimFacesByPlane: trims faces at planes; parameters include projection mode and normal direction

tips.title: Untrim faces
tips.body: UntrimFaces: restores the domain of trimmed faces; parameters include mode and onlyComplementary flag

tips.title: Break shapes
tips.body: BreakShapes: breaks one or several shapes; parameters include target layer and keepOriginal flag

tips.title: Modify face continuity
tips.body: MakeContinuityFace: modifies transitions between two faces; parameters include continuity type and tension

tips.title: Create a point tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.CreatePointTag` with parameters like `name`, `parentCategory`, `description`, `defaultValue`, `readOnlyType`, `readOnlyValues`, `propagate`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Create a real array tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.CreateRealArrayTag` with parameters like `name`, `parentCategory`, `description`, `defaultValue`, `readOnlyType`, `readOnlyValues`, `propagate`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Create an RGB tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.CreateRgbTag` with parameters like `name`, `parentCategory`, `description`, `defaultValue`, `readOnlyType`, `readOnlyValues`, `propagate`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Redefine a tag category
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.RedefineTagCategory` with parameters like `tag`, `newName`, `newDescription`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Redefine a keyword tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.RedefineKeywordTag` with parameters like `tag`, `newName`, `newDescription`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Redefine an integer tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.RedefineIntegerTag` with parameters like `tag`, `newName`, `newDescription`, `newDefaultValue`, `newReadOnlyValues`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Redefine a real tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.RedefineRealTag` with parameters like `tag`, `newName`, `newDescription`, `newDefaultValue`, `newReadOnlyValues`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Redefine a text tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.RedefineTextTag` with parameters like `tag`, `newName`, `newDescription`, `newDefaultValue`, `newReadOnlyValues`, and `warnings`.

tips.title: Redefine a boolean tag
tips.body: Use `om.commands.tags.RedefineBooleanTag` with parameters like `tag`, `newName`, `newDescription`, `newDefaultValue`, `newReadOnlyValues`, and `warnings`.
